ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the visible surface is dominated by high-density, low-intensity (black) pixels with a sparse distribution of high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and trailing edge boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white focal spots are mapped to the extreme distal tips and in isolated, sub-centimeter clusters along the trailing edge and outer leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees, bisecting the two lobes with a sharp vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration. Multiple distinct 'valleys' and 'peaks' are visible, specifically a significant deep indentation on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe and smaller, recurring jagged disruptions across the right lobe trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the peduncle base, transitioning into a jagged, irregular trajectory towards the distal tips due to macro-level serration.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white pixel circularities (barnacles) are concentrated on the dorsal-facing leading edges of both tips and sporadically along the trailing edge serrations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical and diagonal light-gray linear striations are visible on the upper half of the left lobe, cutting across the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and deep notches along the trailing edge, particularly a prominent 'step' indentation on the inner-left lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian subject in the background water, positioned approximately 1.5 fluke-widths to the right of the central notch.
